name: corporate
label: Corporate
css: .style-corporate { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 80px; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .style-corporate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-corporate .hook { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; z-index: 1; } .style-corporate .text { font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; z-index: 1; } .style-corporate .step { position: absolute; top: 80px; right: 80px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.06; margin: 0; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-corporate .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 80px; left: 80px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-corporate { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); } .slide-code.style-corporate .hook, .slide-code.style-corporate .text, .slide-code.style-corporate .step { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-corporate .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-code.style-corporate::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-corporate { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E1B4B 100%); } .slide-insight.style-corporate .hook { color: #F0F9FF; } .slide-insight.style-corporate .text { color: #E0E7FF; } .slide-insight.style-corporate .step { color: #F0F9FF; opacity: 0.08; } .slide-insight.style-corporate .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-corporate .insight-text { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: #E0E7FF; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0.3px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); padding: 24px; border-left: 3px solid var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); margin: 16px 0; border-radius: 4px; } .slide-insight.style-corporate::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.15; }
